_what: The criterion-1 acceptance corpus: one query per served tool, phrased as a USER states the job — never the tool's name, never a phrase lifted from its description. A tool passes when find_tools ranks it in the default top 5. Authored 2026-09-11 by an agent that had read every description, so informed rather than blind; a query from a field report supersedes the one here. Governed by dec:a-tool-carries-the-users-phrasing-and-the-corpus-is-the-test.
